scope: Current mobile contextual-framing automated evidence; no manual conformance certification

notes: Three DealPath scenarios passed with zero axe violations and zero uncaught errors: hire-first, client-first and 320px printed terms.
The 32 passing browser checks cover keyboard navigation, mode switching, persisted reading, skip link, reduced motion, and restoration of inert/hidden secondary groups before keyboard traversal.

Both routes pass axe in ordinary reading; an active phone rate scene also passes axe with only its complete active reading group exposed. Inactive peripheral previews are inert/hidden and restored in normal reading. Automated scans are not complete conformance certification.
The complete flyer and linked proposal notes remain readable without JavaScript; no canvas fallback is needed.
Normal reading and notes have no horizontal overflow. Every complete camera group is tested at 1440×1000, 320×740, 390×844, 430×932 and 390×664; phones DPR3.

Independent critic accepted complete mobile framing and peripheral hierarchy after rejecting the first candidate. Captured primary text minimum is 14.0374px. Measured header/control insets are tested through viewport shrink and restore.
VoiceOver review was not performed. Semantic HTML, axe and keyboard checks are not screen-reader-equivalent manual proof.
A browser-emulated touch gesture is tested; physical iOS/Android devices and notched-screen behavior are unverified.
Viewport reflow is tested. Manual text resizing, browser zoom and forced-colors coverage are not claimed.
